Question B-005-001-007.

Why the correct answer is right: Kilohertz to megahertz requires division by 1 000. 7040 / 1 000 = 7.040 MHz.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "0.740 MHz": This is not a valid kHz-to-MHz conversion; 0.740 / 7.040 = 0.105, so it is about 9.5 times too small and drops a digit.
- sourceIndex 2: "70.40 MHz": This divides 7040 by 100 instead of 1 000, so it is 10 times too large.
- sourceIndex 3: "0.074 MHz": This is not a valid kHz-to-MHz conversion; 0.074 / 7.040 = 0.0105, so it is about 95 times too small and drops a digit.
